description: Everything known about one website: when it launched, what it is, and the technologies detected on it. Give a domain such as example.com (a full URL works too). Returns found: false if the site is not in the corpus. When found, counts one site from the monthly allowance.

domain.description: Domain to look up, e.g. example.com

includeContact.description: Include the site's published contact route (role mailbox and/or contact page) when available. Needs the 'contacts' permission.

includeInfrastructure.description: Include hosting, DNS and email-security details.

includeQuality.description: Include quality bands and whether the site is green hosted.

name: lookup_site
title: Look up one site
